title: Workshop reservation capability
purpose: Document a proposed capability for visitors to reserve a place in a workshop, together with the decisions still unresolved in the supplied source.

scope.text: Let visitors reserve a place in a workshop.

requirements.text: Let visitors reserve a place in a workshop.

stories.text: As a visitor, I want to reserve a place in a workshop.
acceptance_criteria: Given an existing workshop, when a visitor completes a reservation for that workshop, then a place in that workshop is reserved for that visitor.

dependencies.text: We have not decided whether reservations need payment, an account, a capacity limit or cancellation.

open_questions: Is there a capacity limit on workshop reservations, and if so what is it and how is it enforced?
Are reservations cancellable, and if so under what conditions?
Who is the owner of this feature?
What is the release date for this feature?
